data.title: 白面鸮 · 同桌的休息时间
data.description: 她把计时器收好，托腮看着你，认真宣布：“接下来的休息时间，分配给你。”
data.action: 托腮看向镜头，露出浅笑
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting in a cozy wooden cafe booth, Ptilopsis rests her chin in one hand while gazing directly at the viewer across two ceramic latte mugs. Her laboratory lanyard lies neatly folded beside a saucer as warm pendant lamps illuminate her subtly softened gaze.
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin on her hand, she meets the viewer's gaze with a rare, quiet smile, officially designating the scheduled break interval.
